Quest.Title: Open Your Eyes to the Dark
Quest.Script: So. You want to taste that new power, do you? Heh… you are still far too weak. Step outside the castle like this and you will not last. I have no time to tutor you while war burns, but if you prove you have potential, I will teach you. The first basement here is within your reach. Clear out the vermin. I will call when the time comes.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Mmm. The scent of blood on you is promising. I will pass a measure of power to you.
Quest.FailMessage: What are you doing? Carry on like that and you will be nothing but prey for those human insects…

Quest.Title: Awakening as a Vampire
Quest.Script: Young vampire! Why do you still refuse the call of blood? Does some leftover scrap of human morality still nag at you? You chose to abandon humanity, and yet you cling to it. Laughable. Those memories are worthless. Our strength is not a gift. It grows through blood, the root of life. If you want power, you must drink.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Growing used to the drain, are you? Keep it in mind in every fight. Collect what I left with Cacon in the village.
Quest.FailMessage: You would refuse your fate? Fine… regret will not help you once you are ash. Hmm~

Quest.Title: Persuade Larva
Quest.Script: The Master is pleased with how you are growing into the clan. He trusts you will not disappoint him. Still, fools appear now and then — vampires who gained our power and cannot forget their human lives. Larva aids those fools, and that is why this keeps happening. I do not know why the Master will not cast him out. His magic is not to be ignored; if he stood with us, the clan would be stronger. Will you speak with him? Take my letter and try.

Complete.Message: You deliver Bricolacas's letter and try to persuade him, but Larva only shakes his head. He draws a letter of his own and tells you to take it back to Bricolacas.
Complete.Script: I cannot fathom the nerve it takes to decide like that. One day it will draw the Master's wrath… Still, you did well. Keep serving Him faithfully.

Quest.FailMessage: No need to push yourself so hard. It seems I overestimated you.

Fail.Killed: Do not die while delivering the letter.

Quest.Title: An Obedient Beast
Quest.Script: Unlike humans — lowly things that only rebel — other beasts can be obedient. Not all of them are useful, of course. Wild dogs have always bred in Eslania. Tame them well and they become handy tools. Even humans use them. The first days are a bother, but they are worth it. They love meat. Do not forget to bring some.
Quest.CompleteMessage: It will not look like much at first, but raise it steadily and it will come into its own. With luck it may even strengthen you. It might also carry a foul sickness. Show it to Capatini in Castle Limbo; he will examine it.

Complete.TamePet: Tame a Junior Wolfarch and obtain a Wolf Dog.

Quest.FailMessage: Keh. Cannot even tame a mongrel… How do you expect to survive here?

Quest.Title: A Pact with the Demon
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Lilith Jera Option: VIS+2 Exp: 200 Money: 10,000 Geld
Quest.Script: So Lilith's power is returning, is it? Heh… my voice will sound strange to you. You are not yet worthy to look upon me. Defy me, and you will be nothing but a toy for the secret agents. I have no time to tutor you in this chaos, but if you prove you can become a warrior, Lilith's teaching will walk with you. There is a condition: you will bind yourself to me. First, go to Bricolacas in Castle Limbo, collect your gear and funds, and begin. A pact with me is never easy. I will call when the time comes. Eheheh…
Quest.CompleteMessage: You would make a pact with me? Heh. Good. This is my gift to help a wretched thing like you through the quests. Lose it or let it be stolen, and your life is mine. My order is your blood. Do not forget my words.
Quest.FailMessage: You pathetic weakling! I will hunt you and make your life a misery! Ahahaha!

Quest.Title: Take the Dungeon
Quest.RewardMessage: (Random weapon by domain) Name: Lilith SAV Knuckle Option: STR+3 / INT+3
Quest.Script: Our pact lets me give you orders anywhere, any time. You already signed it. There is no running. Speak of this to anyone and you die. First I will test whether you are the warrior Lilith foretold. This dungeon is crawling with trash. Take their heads as I command. Watch your jewels stain with blood. Miss that, and I will be disappointed. You belong to me now.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Better than I expected. Remember that I am always watching. This reward is my lash. Keep pleasing me.
Quest.FailMessage: Do you need more pain, or do you simply need to die?

Quest.Title: Larva's Taste
Quest.RewardMessage: 20 Bat Wings Starts quest 108
Quest.Script: Here is your first order. Take this to Larva in southeast Limbo. His tastes are peculiar, but he will help a pure-blooded vampire endure what is coming. Your road of pain has only begun. No talk. Go to Larva and wait for my next command.
Quest.CompleteMessage: So you are Lilith's heir? And how did you come by that disgusting head? Few know I collect such things… Heh. You will not need it now, but keep it. You will want it later.
Quest.FailMessage: Why are you back? What? You lost the bat head? What did you waste it on, you idiot?

Quest.Title: A Distasteful Task
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Lilith Slippery Robe Option: ATTR+2 Lilith Plume Cloak Option: ATTR+2 (male / female)
Quest.Script: Here is your task. Creatures have been souring my mood. I could crush them myself, but you are nothing. If you cannot even match them, you are not worth speaking to. They scout southeast Castle Limbo with eyes like ours, using cheap tricks. Go there and wipe the filth out. Be swift. Begin.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Crueler work is coming. Watch yourself… hahaha.
Quest.FailMessage: Not even worth my disappointment. Get out of my sight or I will kill you.

Quest.Title: Paint the Map in Blood
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Lilith Anti-Sun Ring x2 Option: RES+1
Quest.Script: You handled the last task well. Larva liked my gift. Do not grow proud over one errand. You will die soon enough. Heh. This next one can kill you. You have hunted chiefs on a timer before, but there are always exceptions. A warrior of Lilith might claw back from hell itself. No one else leaves my hand alive. Temerie Holy Land lies in southwest Eslania. We have drunk deep there; now it is a battlefield. Take enemy heads, drink, hunt the chiefs, and come back in glory.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Take this reward. I do not praise lightly. Wait in silence for my whisper. I am watching you, always. Hahaha!
Quest.FailMessage: Still beneath what I want? Do you wish to taste the fire of hell?

Quest.Title: The Demon's Call
Quest.RewardMessage: 5 Cerberus Seals 4 Hearts of Cabracam B1 Starts quest 111
Quest.Script: You lived. That is one step toward Lilith's glory, but you are not enough. I will test you again. My sight caught Slayers moving. A fool vampire hid something important in a house near the Drobeta mill sewers, and the Slayers found it. I marked your map. Use the bat wings Larva gave you and get there first. Stay off the roaming beasts; the ground is still too dangerous for you. Move. Now.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Take your next order at once.

Complete.TouchWayPoint: Search Drobeta SE at X=206, Y=190

Quest.FailMessage: I will not kill you for failing, but you look ridiculous. Come back like that again and I will end you.

Fail.Killed: Do not die more than 3 times during the mission.

Quest.Title: Warrior of Darkness
Quest.RewardMessage: 20 Cerberus Seals Exp: 3000 Money: 50,000 Geld
Quest.Script: You snatched it in time. Listen well. Take it to Menegroth B1 and kill Cabracam before the Slayers do. He holds something precious. Show this seal to Belegost northwest of Castle Limbo to enter. Use the heart I give you, join whoever is already there, and take the boss first. You will earn Osiris's token — too fine for you, but I will allow it. Claim the token and I will add a special reward. Now go to hell. You have one hour on B1.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Wiping that smug look off your face over one little job? Hahaha.
Quest.FailMessage: I expected as much. Still, you suffered for it. Tend your wounds, you useless thing.

Quest.Title: Training to Survive
Quest.Script: You are the new transfer? Headquarters must be desperate, sending a soldier with no training. Walk out of HQ like that and you are vampire meat. Fine. I will put you through hard training in the special yard. See Tanya for directions. Specialty training comes after.
Quest.CompleteMessage: You have been working. Good. Specialty training starts now. Fall in.
Quest.FailMessage: Another torture officer is born. Keep stumbling and Zack will make your life hell. If it gets too rough, you can always buy supplies from me. Hahaha.

Quest.Title: Training Never Ends
Quest.Script: Listen, recruit. You can finally learn a skill. Used well, skills win fights and grow you fast. Show me. Raise any skill to the required level.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Better than I thought. You might actually be useful. Take your voucher to Nancy for supplies.
Quest.FailMessage: What are you doing? We are not fighting scarecrows. This is not a playground. Wake up!

Reward.SayNPC: Take the supply voucher to Nancy and collect your kit

Quest.Title: Recover the Intel
Quest.Script: Our scouts have been gathering intel on vampire holds. A trooper surveying a nest northwest of the Perona highway went silent. He is almost certainly dead, but his data must come back. The site is close to the enemy. His last signal was Eslania NW, 67, 58. Motorcycle noise will draw vampires. No bikes on this run.

Complete.Message: So they killed him. At least he did not rise as a vampire… If you have the data, withdraw and take it to Tanya.
Good. You made it back. Rest and kit up until the next order.

Quest.FailMessage: I was wrong to give a greenhorn an intel recovery. I will not punish you for the failure. Command, however, will punish me.

Fail.Killed: Do not die during the mission.

Quest.Title: War Dog Manual
Quest.Script: Wild dogs in Eslania can be trained as war dogs. A war dog will help in the field. Your task is to raise one. Capture a wild dog first. They love meat. Do not forget it. That is all.
Quest.CompleteMessage: You caught one. Return to base for a fitness check. Terry will examine it.
Quest.FailMessage: Cannot even catch a stray, and you expect to hunt vampires? How did you become an EVE trooper?

Quest.Title: Secret Agent Selection
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Valkyrie Medium Belt Option: HP+2 Exp: 200 Money: 10,000 Ray
Quest.Script: Congratulations. You have been chosen as an EVE secret agent. I train and command those agents. You will learn my name in time; not knowing it yet is safer for you. Pass the new trials and you will take darker work, and you will be a true Highlander. The war is urgent, but then you will understand why we trained you from the start. See Zack at Field HQ for gear and funds, and begin. Every mission goes through me. This is not recruit drill.
Quest.CompleteMessage: You are taking this seriously. Good. Do not slack before the next test.
Quest.FailMessage: You would abandon a sacred duty?

Quest.Title: First Trial
Quest.RewardMessage: (Valkyrie weapon by domain) Option: STR+3 / INT+3 Bonus Exp: 400
Quest.Script: Congratulations on becoming a full EVE agent. A system now lets me assign you work anywhere. It is a secure line between a special agent and the commander. Guard it. First order: enter the virtual yard and fight stronger foes. Hunt the chiefs I name before time runs out. You are still in training.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Better than I expected. I am always watching. You may yet make a proper secret agent.
Quest.FailMessage: Perhaps secret work does not suit you?

Quest.Title: Find Jack
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Valkyrie Scorpion Key Starts quest 208
Quest.Script: You passed. Training ends here. From now you work in secret. It will be hard, but the title of glory waits at the end. Your first special task: take this medal to Jack and request special gear. He will help you endure what comes. This is only the beginning. Go to Jack at Field HQ.
Quest.CompleteMessage: A finished agent, are you? If you completed the test, you brought what I asked for. Good. Take your reward.
Quest.FailMessage: Why are you back? The medal is gone? Attempt the mission without Jack and you will come home a corpse.

Quest.Title: A Harsh Mission
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Valkyrie Battle Suit (M) / Valkyrie Leggings (M) Option: ATTR+1 / ATTR+1 Name: Valkyrie Battle Suit (W) / Valkyrie Leggings (W) Option: ATTR+1 / ATTR+1 (male / female) Bonus Exp: 1000
Quest.Script: Your task. Our specials have scouted Eslania faster than anyone since we were formed. An agent in northwest Eslania reports others watching the same ground. They are trained, and they use tricks. Go to their hunting grounds and wipe them out. Northwest Eslania. Use Jack's gift. Take the motorcycle and be faster than they are. Begin.
Quest.CompleteMessage: What comes next will not be easy. Watch yourself…
Quest.FailMessage: Afraid? Or simply not able? Do not keep disappointing me.

Quest.Title: A Map of Glory
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Valkyrie Aurous Ring x2 Option: RES+1 / RES+1 Bonus Exp: 2000
Quest.Script: Well done. Jack says the last job was clean. Do not grow proud. Carelessness is death. This one may be dangerous. You have hunted chiefs on a clock, but exceptions happen, and a special agent must meet them. Two lives would not be enough, and still I trust you. Temerie Holy Land in southwest Eslania has cost us dearly. Enemies wait for your throat. It is a battlefield. Slip past their eyes, take the chiefs, and return in glory. If they learn who you are, die by your own hand before they take you.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Stay alive until the next order.
Quest.FailMessage: Why did you not take your own life? Still short of what I need? I want you dead, but I will give you one chance. My patience has a limit.

Quest.Title: A Cryptic Order
Quest.RewardMessage: 5 Cerberus Seals 4 Hearts of Cabracam B1 Starts quest 211
Quest.Script: Briefing, soldier. If you have lived this far, you stand at the heart of the Valkyrie operation that will lead us toward heaven. The road is still long. This run will test your nerve. Stolen convoy goods have turned up in a house near the Drobeta mill sewers. Exact coordinates are unknown; ride to the mark on your GPS and search the area. Recover the materiel. I will give the next order then. Do not clear the district. It is still too hot for you.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Take the next mission at once.

Complete.TouchWayPoint: Search Drobeta SE at X=206, Y=190

Quest.FailMessage: I will not court-martial you for failing, but I am disappointed. What went wrong?

Fail.Killed: Do not die more than 3 times during the mission.

Quest.Title: Into the Dark Below
Quest.RewardMessage: 20 Cerberus Seals Exp: 3000 Money: 50,000 Ray
Quest.Script: Well done. You recovered it. This next run is urgent and deadly. Take the goods to Menegroth B1 and stop the boss. Cabracam has been tearing apart the agents we sent to check the vampires. Show the seal to Argonas west of Field HQ, enter, use the heart to call Cabracam, and kill him with the agents already inside. Hideous work, but you will earn Kali's token, and I permit you to keep it. Survive and I will add a special reward. You have one hour on B1. Come back alive.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Stay alive until the next order.
Quest.FailMessage: I expected as much. This may still be too much for you. Get your wounds treated, and rest.

Quest.Title: Reclaim Your Strength
Quest.Script: May nature's glory walk with you. Welcome, comrade. The vampires' uprising tore you from a sweet sleep, and I still feel how weak you are. To face the destroyers beyond the village you must wake the power that slept with you. Carisas's ward still holds as far as Hanial Dungeon B1. Feeble things wander there. Use them to open your strength, little by little. Time is short. Reclaim your power now.
Quest.CompleteMessage: I feel some of your power opening. Our strength grows. Lavinia in the village can help you.
Quest.FailMessage: Nature is never idle. You are part of it, and you must follow its law. Try harder…

Quest.Title: Spirit, the Source of Power
Quest.Script: Forced lessons mean nothing to us. How you grow the gift nature gave you is your will alone. Do not forget that you need spirit to use it. Keep that well from running dry.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Never forget spirit drain if you mean to open your power. I asked Lipati to prepare something that may help you on the road.
Quest.FailMessage: Do not call spirit drain cruel or a chore. It is necessary to cleanse the vampires. If you refuse it, I will not force you.

Quest.Title: The Threat of a Poisoned Land
Quest.Script: Our clan has lived by kind nature after years of exile. Humans and vampires keep poisoning the Mother's earth. The human works next to our refuge could fall to vampires at any time. I believe you can look over that place. Sylph-power is unstable; seal it for this task.
Quest.CompleteMessage: No great threat yet, which is a mercy. That destructive vampires still haunt the site is a grave worry. Watch it more closely.
Quest.FailMessage: I feel your mind fraying. You cannot handle this as you are. Learn to govern yourself. To govern yourself, you must know yourself…

Fail.Killed: Do not die during the mission.

Quest.Title: Another Companion
Quest.Script: Unlike the invaders with their stained souls, lives that follow nature will lend us strength. Their numbers have fallen, but wild dogs still wait for allies. tame their hunger and they will serve you faithfully.
Quest.CompleteMessage: They too follow nature. Raise their gifts and live beside them. Any who follow you will share Carisas's protection.
Quest.FailMessage: Nature is not ruled by force. Seek everything through power and you are no better than a vampire. Growing close to nature matters more than anything. You failed this time. Show me you can improve.

Quest.Title: Wrath of Nature
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Nature's Wave Armsband Option: HP+2 Exp: 200 Money: 10,000 Zad
Quest.Script: What are you doing? Can you not hear my cry? Unseen is not the same as gone. Listen to me. Refuse, and only ruin remains. The hour is desperate. Reach for nature's power yourself. Show that will, and the great force of nature will walk with you. There is a condition: travel with me and obey. Go to Lipati in the Ousters village, take your gear and funds, and begin. We must stop our people's end.
Quest.CompleteMessage: You heard me. This gift will guide you through every quest to come. Do not lose it. It is my life, and my word is everyone's life. Do not forget.
Quest.FailMessage: You must not be this weak. The middle world is our only path, my kin…

Quest.Title: Like the Wind
Quest.RewardMessage: (Random weapon by domain) Name: Nature's Raetra Chakram Option: STR+3 Name: Nature's Lacrima Wristlet Option: INT+3
Quest.Script: My voice startled you, I know. Our pact now lets me give you tasks anywhere. My power will aid you. Tell no one. The dungeon is full of wicked things. Cut them down as I say. Watch your map fill with blessing. You must check it. You and I walk together now.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Better than I thought. I watch to keep you safe. This reward is my blessing. Strive harder still.
Quest.FailMessage: Do you not know what greater pain is? Would you live alone and watch our people erased?

Quest.Title: Amata's Gift
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Nature's Wave Armsband Option: HP+2 Starts quest 308
Quest.Script: The work of reclaiming the middle world has begun. Nature's great power will lead you. Amata will help you endure what is coming. This is only the start. Take this to Amata in the Ousters village and receive your task.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. As an Ousters warrior you will face harder pain still. You brought what I asked for? Good. Take your reward.
Quest.FailMessage: Why are you back? The spirit is gone? How could that happen…

Quest.Title: Blade Wind
Quest.RewardMessage: Nature's Sprite Coat Option: ATTR+1 Nature's Sprite Boots Option: ATTR+1
Quest.Script: A dangerous task. Our spirits have been scouting this land. In northwest Castalo we found others watching the same ground, trained and using tricks. Go to southeast Castle Limbo, their hunting ground, and wipe them out. Use the gear you were given and be faster than they are. Begin.
Quest.CompleteMessage: What comes next will not be easy. Watch yourself…
Quest.FailMessage: Did I fail to see how short your strength still is? Please, find more power.

Quest.Title: A Shining Insignia
Quest.RewardMessage: Name: Nature's Empos Ring x2 Option: RES+1
Quest.Script: The last task was excellent. Amata told me so. Do not grow proud over one errand. The moment you ease your guard, death's shadow comes. This next work may be dangerous. You have hunted chiefs on a timer, and exceptions always come, but nature's power can keep you alive. I already trust you. Temerie Holy Land in southwest Eslania has cost us much. Enemies still wait for your life. It is a ruined, bloody field. Slip past their eyes with that bright speed, take the chiefs, and return. May nature's blessing stay with you…
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Take this reward. Wait quietly for my whisper until the next task. I watch over you, always.
Quest.FailMessage: Still short of what I need? Please, do not make me abandon our people.

Quest.Title: Storm Zone
Quest.RewardMessage: 5 Cerberus Seals 4 Hearts of Cabracam B1 Starts quest 211
Quest.Script: If you have lived this far, you already stand at the heart of this Nature conquest that will lead our people to peace. The road is still long. I will look at your strength once more. The wind says lesser beings who ignore nature's law are fighting. Near a house by the Drobeta mill sewers, vampires and Slayers have gone to war over something precious. We must take it first. I marked your map, but you will need to search. Use a sylph; there is no time. Avoid the roaming beasts. That ground is still too dangerous for you.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Begin the next task at once.

Complete.TouchWayPoint: Search Drobeta SE at X=206, Y=190

Quest.FailMessage: I will not despair over a failure, but I fear for our people's fate…

Fail.Killed: Do not die more than 3 times during the mission.

Quest.Title: Turn Darkness to Light
Quest.RewardMessage: 20 Cerberus Seals Exp: 3000 Money: 50,000 Zad
Quest.Script: Your next task is deadly, and time is gone. Take what you recovered to Menegroth B1. Cabracam, the underground boss, is killing our kin. Show this seal to Ea east of the Ousters village to enter. Use the heart to summon Cabracam and slay him with those already holding the floor. Hideous work, but you will earn Lir's token, and it is yours. Return alive and I will add a special reward. I promise. You have one hour on B1. Come back living.
Quest.CompleteMessage: Well done. Peace until the next task.
Quest.FailMessage: I expected as much. This may still be too much. Get your wounds treated, and rest.
